text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's Day, and Хиши Амадзон
and I are
out on our first shrine visit of
the year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Clap, clap!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This year will be quite the challenge for
Hishi
Amazon. I wonder what she prayed
for...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Phew! Finally, we're done! That line was
way
longer than I thought it would be.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Huh? The same thing as always—good
health for
everyone important to me!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Oh, I wouldn't have guessed that.

text_block_list.text: You seem surprised. Well, I can see why.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I've got some big races coming up this
year, and I
did think about prayin' for
some good luck.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
But it's not my style to ask for divine
favor. If I'm
gonna win, it's gonna be with
the efforts we put
toward victory
together, eh?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Such a confident answer is so true to her
nature
that, without noticing, I break
into a smile.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So, what should we do after this? We
could dive
straight into some training.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Her suggestion isn't bad, but since it's
New Year's
and everything, I feel it
would be more
appropriate to celebrate.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: How about we get something to eat?
Do you want to try practicing some party tricks?
Let's make some traditional New Year's dishes.

text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's a great idea! My stomach's
just startin'
to get rumbly.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We tour the stalls on the shrine grounds,
sampling
what they have to offer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that was great! Grilled squid
tastes even
better when you eat it
outside!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Teach! Your hands are all
sticky!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I must have gotten sauce on them while
eating.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Gosh, you're hopeless. Here, use this
wet wipe to
clean up.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds like fun! I know of a
cool
one—you know the one where you
pull a
tablecloth off a table?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I'm always scared—I mean surprised—by Fuji's magic tricks, so I wanna do something cool too!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: It's about time I leave her speechless for once!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Okay, the tablecloth is ready, and so are
the
plates and glasses!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Heh, it looked like a cinch in that video I

watched. I'm gonna nail this in one go!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Raargh!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Craaaaash!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wha?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice idea! It might take a while, but
it'll be a
great chance to show off my
skills!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: All right, let's shop for ingredients!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Now to take the bamboo mat off and...
Nice, the
sweet rolled omelet came out
just right!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
How are the kelp rolls doing, Teach?
We've been
simmering 'em for some
time, so the broth should
have cooked
off by now.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Now it's really starting to smell
like New
Year's.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We spend the rest of New Year's Day
strolling
about at our leisure and have a
nice, relaxing
time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We work together to cook up a delicious
spread
for New Year's.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
For the rest of the day, she continues
practicing
the trick until she's satisfied
with her progress.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This year is going to be a decisive one
for us, and
I want to push through it at
full throttle together
with Хиши Амадзон.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
